title: Techno Panic Universe
titleNative: てくのぱにっくゆにばーす
synopsis: In a desperate bid to save the "Hashidate University High-Dimensional Engineering Laboratory" from closure, the genius—and stunningly beautiful—Professor Enri Nagisawa races across campus in search of new recruits. She soon joins forces with three eccentric girls—an "Android from Outer Space," a "Mecha-Obsessed Disciplinary Committee Member," and a "Masochistic Heiress"—and together, they transcend the bounds of reality to do whatever they please! "Even if you're an outcast, you're never alone." Get ready for a sci-fi Yuri comedy that’s mostly side-splittingly funny—with just a few moments that might bring a tear to your eye! (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

synopsis: I, the earthling "hero" of this story, crossed over into another world based on a video game and suddenly appeared in a villainous female demon's bed when I arrived. If not for the fact that I had married all the villains in the game before crossing over, I'd have been killed pretty quickly. Now, the villains keep pestering me, asking me to help them rule the world, and vying for my hand in marriage. What am I supposed to do? I'll await your answers online! It's urgent! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

synopsis: Rintaro Shido, a high school boy who aspires to become a full-time house-husband, is in the same class with Rei Otosaki, a popular and well-known idol. The two have no relationship other than being classmates, but that changes drastically when Rintaro serves Rei a home-cooked meal after she nearly collapses from hunger! The food was so delicious that Rei asks him, "Can I come and eat with you every day?" (Source: Comic Gardo, translated)

title: DIG IT
synopsis: Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he's played as his team's ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that's a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can't play the style his father demands, but swears he'll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that's entirely his own. (Source: K MANGA)

title: TSUYOSHI: Daremo Katenai, Aitsu ni wa
titleRomaji: TSUYOSHI: Daremo Katenai, Aitsu ni wa
titleNative: TSUYOSHI 誰も勝てない、アイツには
synonyms: TSUYOSHI: The one who no one can win against
Tsuyoshi ไอ้หนุ่มหมัดพิฆาตลูกป๋องแป๋ง
synopsis: Tsuyoshi Kawabata is just a regular convenience store employee in a mid-sized city west of Tokyo. Except... he also happens to be the most powerful fighter in the world. Although he doesn't particularly want to fight, his reputation precedes him, and martial artists come from all over the world to test their might against the mythical Tsuyoshi – and invariably end up handily beaten, clutching their battered family jewels in a convenience store parking lot. Should you wish to fight him, he has three rules to minimize inconvenience: 1) You only get one fight. There will be no rematch. 2) You will fight in a secluded area, where you won't be seen. 3) You will tell nobody about it – even if you lose.

title: Arabesque Koukyuu no Wakoku-hime
titleNative: アラベスク後宮の和国姫
synopsis: Lyra, a consort whose name will be passed down to future generations as a legend, was originally a princess of the Kingdom of Wa. She was captured in a conspiracy and forced into the harem of the Daril Empire. However, in this harem, she had a path to freedom if she remained childless for several years! This gave her hope, and she resolved not to approach the Sultan, but to wait until her term of indenture expired. However, she was soon tested by the Empress and provoked by a haughty consort candidate. Lyra overcame numerous adversities by displaying the intelligence and natural cheerfulness forged by her parents. She gradually became beloved by those around her, and even showed glimpses of her potential as a wise ruler... But as a result, why has she risen to the top and been treated as a favorite concubine? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Teto X Egen
synopsis: Ha-Seon, a “workaholic” for whom her company and job are her whole life, and Seon-Ho, a “homebody” whose world consists only of his home and his cat. These two seemed as unlikely to cross paths as parallel lines. But not only are they assigned to the same task force, it turns out they’re actually neighbors, and their daily lives begin to get tangled up. Just when things are getting complicated, Seon-Ho’s first love shows up…! What will become of this precarious yet strangely thrilling relationship between two people who lived in completely different worlds? (Source: Millie, translated)

title: Comet-san
synopsis: The story revolves around Princess Comet, a twelve-year-old girl who is also the princess of the Harmonica Star country of the Triangle Nebula. She was meant to meet the prince of the Tambourine Star country at a ball, but the prince ran away to Earth instead. As it turned out, Comet is sent to Earth to find him, though she has no idea what he looks like. "He will be known by the twinkling in his eyes" is the only clue she was given to the prince's identity. Once she travels to Earth, Comet falls in love with the people she meets there as well as the planet itself, quickly becoming attached to life on Earth. (Source: Wikipedia)
